title: OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 (Level 2)
description: Maps findings to OWASP Application Security Verification Standard requirements. Use when the audience expects a recognised application-security baseline.

gate.note: ASVS L2 treats unauthenticated access to privileged functionality and committed credentials as non-negotiable.

SEC-XSS-DANGEROUS-HTML.title: Context-aware output escaping protects against reflected, stored and DOM XSS

SEC-MARKDOWN-HTML-SINK.title: Context-aware output escaping protects against reflected, stored and DOM XSS
Untrusted markup is sanitised before rendering

SEC-TOKEN-WEBSTORAGE.title: Cookie-based session tokens use the Secure attribute
Sensitive data is not stored in browser storage accessible to client script

SEC-JWT-CLIENT-TRUST.title: Stateless tokens are verified using a trusted signature
Access controls are enforced on a trusted service layer

SEC-CLIENT-SIDE-AUTHZ.title: Access controls are enforced on a trusted service layer
Access control decisions use a single verified mechanism

SEC-UNAUTH-HANDLER.title: Access controls are enforced on a trusted service layer
Trusted enforcement points cannot be bypassed

SEC-CHILD-PROCESS-SHELL.title: OS command injection is prevented by avoiding shell interpolation

SEC-PATH-TRAVERSAL.title: User-supplied filename metadata cannot traverse the filesystem

SEC-SSRF-FETCH.title: Server-side requests validate destinations against an allowlist
URL redirects and forwards validate untrusted data

SEC-WEAK-CRYPTO.title: Random values use a cryptographically secure generator

SEC-TIMING-UNSAFE-COMPARE.title: Verification of cryptographic authenticators resists side channels

SEC-CRYPTO-IV-REUSE.title: Insecure block modes and unsafe padding are not used
Nonces and initialisation vectors are not reused with a static key

SEC-WEBCRYPTO-MISUSE.title: Key material is protected from unauthorised access
Approved key derivation with adequate cost parameters

SEC-SIGNATURE-VERIFY-DISCARDED.title: Cryptographic modules fail securely and errors are handled correctly
Signed tokens are verified and unsigned algorithms rejected

SEC-EVAL.title: Dynamic code execution features are avoided

SEC-SECRET-IN-CLIENT-BUNDLE.title: Build artefacts do not disclose secrets or sensitive configuration
Secrets are protected from unauthorised disclosure

SEC-CSP-MISSING.title: A Content-Security-Policy response header is set

SEC-POSTMESSAGE-ORIGIN.title: Cross-document messaging validates the sender origin

SEC-TARGET-BLANK.title: Safe browsing context controls are applied

SEC-SECRET-COMMITTED.title: Secrets are stored in a protected secret store, not in source
All components are kept free of embedded credentials

DEP-ADVISORY.title: All components are up to date with a documented vulnerability review

DOCKER-ROOT.title: Application processes run with least privilege

DOCKER-UNPINNED-BASE.title: Component inventory and provenance are verifiable

DOCKER-SECRET-ARG.title: Build configuration does not embed secrets

CI-NO-SECURITY-GATE.title: Dependency vulnerability checks are part of the build

CI-UNPINNED-ACTION.title: Build dependencies are pinned to verifiable versions

CI-RISKY-TRIGGER.title: Build pipeline protects privileged contexts from untrusted input

QUA-SWALLOWED-CATCH.title: Errors are handled without failing open

QUA-CONSOLE-LOGGING.title: A common logging format is used across the application
